when: case "$OMH_TOOL_FILE" in /work/.omh/notes/*) false ;; /work/.omh/*) true ;; *) false ;; esac
refuse: $OMH_TOOL_FILE decides what the next session gets and what `omh sNN commit` runs before it lands anything. Editing it from inside this session is the session approving its own work — ask on the host instead.
